title: WAY TOO MANY GUNS
description: This project combines a bunch of gun mods to make an ultamite gun modpack
body:
This mod adds a lot off guns to the game becuase thats literaly what the name states and this mod lets you try out a bunch of gun mods so you could test too see if you like some of the mods and want to put themin your own modpack and here are all the mods:
1.Just enough guns
2.stabx modern guns
3.Mo' than enough guns
4.Gun collection: A cgm weapon addon
5.Guns and weapons
6.Gun unleashed
7.vanilla animated guns 
8.Craftable gun powder
9. Mr.crayfishes gun mod
10.framework.
